customTheme.title: Custom CSS · Vibe Coding
customTheme.description: Style the entire app with CSS: colors, fonts, tab shapes, backgrounds and pseudo-elements. Preview first, then apply to save across launches and windows.

customTheme.warning: Only apply CSS you trust. It can hide controls or request external URLs. Imported CSS is not applied automatically. Embedded local images stay in the CSS; previewed documents never execute JavaScript.

database.title: Databases
database.pickDatabase: Select a database to list its tables.
database.pickTable: Select a table to preview its data, or run SQL above.
database.sqliteHint: Enter the SQLite file path on the server and press Enter.

redis.scanHint: Enter a pattern (e.g. user:*) and scan to browse keys.

plugins.readyToRun: Choose an action and run it against the active session.

server-performance.name: Server Performance
server-performance.description: Live CPU, memory, disk, network, load and uptime metrics for the active host.

docker-containers.name: Docker Containers
docker-containers.description: Inspect and manage containers, images, volumes, networks, resource usage, logs and container lifecycle through the local or remote Docker CLI.

kubernetes-pods.name: Kubernetes Pods
kubernetes-pods.description: Inspect cluster contexts, namespaces, pods, deployments and workload logs with kubectl.

database-inspector.name: Database Inspector
database-inspector.description: Read PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite metadata. When the client binary is missing on the host, PostgreSQL and MySQL are queried inside their Docker containers.

redis-inspector.name: Redis Inspector
redis-inspector.description: Inspect and manage Redis: health, keyspace stats, key lookups, clients, slowlog and runtime configuration. Falls back to a Docker redis container when redis-cli is absent.

cron-scheduler.name: Scheduled Tasks
cron-scheduler.description: Manage cron jobs: browse the user crontab, /etc/crontab and /etc/cron.d, inspect systemd timers, and add or remove entries.

systemd-services.name: Systemd Services
systemd-services.description: Browse systemd services with their state, and start, stop or restart them.

process-explorer.name: Process Explorer
process-explorer.description: Inspect and manage running processes: sort by CPU or memory, inspect details, and terminate processes by PID.

system-logs.name: System Logs
system-logs.description: Read recent systemd journal entries and service logs from the active server.

network-inspector.name: Network Inspector
network-inspector.description: Inspect listening sockets, routes and DNS configuration on the connected server.

disk-usage.name: Disk Usage
disk-usage.description: Inspect filesystems and directory usage before a full disk becomes an incident.

git-workspace.name: Git Workspace
git-workspace.description: Inspect repository status, branches and recent commits in the remote login directory.
